def coordinates(s, x):
    from scipy.optimize import least_squares
    (A, aw) = op(s, 'panel_a', 'v', af, [2.15, 2.15])
    (B, _) = op(s, 'panel_b', 'v', bf, [2.15, 2.15])
    (C2, _) = op(s, 'panel_c', 'v2', cf, [2.15, 2.15])
    pc = s['panel_c']
    cw = fit(c1f(pc['u']), pc['v1'])
    z0 = np.linalg.solve(aw[1:5].T, (x - aw[0]).T).T
    z = np.array([least_squares(lambda z: A(z[None])[0] - xi, np.clip(zi, -1.3, 1.3), bounds=(-2, 2), gtol=1e-12).x for (xi, zi) in zip(x, z0)])
    return dict(z=z, b=B(z), c=c1f(z) @ cw, h=C2(z))
